name: Terres du Midi
terms: Indication Géographique Protégée, the tier below AOC. It replaced vin de pays in 2009.

blurb.text: A regional French IGP for red, rosé and white still wines from across Languedoc-Roussillon. It covers the same area as Pays d'Oc, but is a blended wine where Pays d'Oc is mostly single-grape.
